title: Revisiting The Classics: A Study on Identifying and Rectifying Gender Stereotypes in Rhymes and Poems

bias_targets.methodology: Creating an annotated dataset of children's rhymes and poems to identify explicit gender stereotypes, training classification models (XGBoost and BERT) using a custom Heuristic Encoder, and evaluating the reduction of gender bias in texts rectified by an LLM (ChatGPT) versus human educators through a comparative participant survey.
